searchText: MSRP $161,970. New 2027 Entegra Odyssey SE 31FF Luxury Class C RV. Features Customer Value Package Dual 13.5K ACS Hydraulic Auto Leveling Jacks 200W Roof Mounted Solar Panel w/ 2nd House Battery More About This RV The Odyssey SE features the Ford® V8, Catalytic converter theft deterrent system and tire pressure monitoring system.
